annotation.title_en: Apply AI: AI-Driven Robotics for Industry: Enabling System Integration and Adoption (IA) (Partnership in AI, Data and Robotics)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Horizon Europe (site français) / Ministère de l'enseignement supérieur, de la recherche et de l'espace
annotation.summary_en: French Horizon Europe portal page describing the 2027 call topic HORIZON-CL4-2027-04-DIGITAL-EMERGING-05, an Innovation Action with a €18M budget to support system integration and adoption of AI-driven industrial robotics, with interoperable frameworks, standardized protocols and system-integrator upskilling.
key_provisions_or_claims: Innovation Action with €18M budget; opens 17 Nov 2026, closes 18 Mar 2027
Aims to speed deployment of AI-powered robotics and bridge providers and end-users
Expects modular, interoperable integration frameworks and standardized protocols for safety testing and validation
Targets upskilling of system integrators and SME competitiveness
Part of the Apply AI Strategy and the AI, Data and Robotics Partnership
